# Differences from the originals

Where BlitzLLVM can not behave like Blitz3D or BlitzPlus, because the system they were made for is gone, or where it does more than they did, this is how it behaves instead.

This page is made from the pages it links to (see `tools/wiki/wiki.py`), so it is not edited by hand: a command lists its differences with `@gap` in its text file, and a difference that no single command causes gets a page in `tools/wiki/pages/` with a line `@difference` and a one sentence summary.

## Features

Differences that are not caused by one command.

* [Asynchronous loading](Asynchronous-Loading): Extension: `AsyncLoading` makes `LoadTexture`, `LoadImage`, `LoadMesh` and `LoadAnimMesh` decode on other threads, and `TextureReady`, `ImageReady` and `EntityReady` say whether something is done.
* [Blitz-Recompiler](Blitz-Recompiler): Extension: `blitz-recompiler` turns an executable made by the original Blitz3D or BlitzPlus compiler into a BlitzLLVM program; the original has no such tool.
* [Colors](Colors): 3D color commands take floats from 0 to 255 and vertex colors are 16-bit floats.
* [CPU optimizations](CPU-Optimizations): Extension: the runtime uses optional CPU instruction sets, several threads and its own memory allocator to be faster.
* [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks): Extension: a program compiled with `-d` stops with an error when a command is given a handle that names nothing, and always loads and saves on the spot.
* [Debug handle checks: Runtime errors as breakpoints](Debug-Handle-Checks#runtime-errors-as-breakpoints): Extension: in a program compiled with `-d`, a runtime error stops in an attached debugger like a breakpoint.
* [GPU optimizations](GPU-Optimizations): Extension: `CameraCulling` chooses what is left out of the picture before it is drawn, and `CameraCullingSource` shows what a camera leaves out. The picture is the same.
* [GPU optimizations: Sprite shapes](GPU-Optimizations#sprite-shapes): Sprites with a round or cut-out texture are drawn as the smallest octagon that the texture can be seen in, not as a square; the picture is the same within one level of a color.
* [Image formats](Image-Formats): Picture files: JPEG 2000 is not read, TIFF only without Deflate or JPEG compression, but WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, DDS and several other formats are.
* [Include Files](Include-Files): Extension: `Include "<keys.bb>"` includes a file shipped with BlitzLLVM, such as the constants of the key codes.
* [IPv6](IPv6): The network commands also work over IPv6, and have text versions of the commands that use an address as a whole number.
* [Language: Data](Language#data): A `Const` that holds a Float or a String can not be used in a `Data` value yet, only a Const that holds an integer.
* [Lost graphics device](Lost-Graphics-Device): Extension: a graphics device that is lost (a driver crash, a GPU reset) is made again, and a device that keeps getting lost within a few minutes ends the program with an error.
* [Model formats](Model-Formats): Extension: `LoadMesh` and `LoadAnimMesh` also read `.3ds` and glTF 2.0 (`.gltf`, `.glb`) files, and `LoadTexture` and `LoadImage` read the pictures inside glTF files. A damaged DirectX `.x` file loads what is before the damage, with a warning.
* [Movie controls](Movie-Controls): Extension: movies can be paused, and the commands for that build on the original movie commands.
* [Multiplayer](Multiplayer): Multiplayer uses TCP on port 40500 instead of DirectPlay, so games only play with other BlitzLLVM games.
* [Parameter modes (In, Out, InOut)](Parameter-Modes): Extension: function parameters can be written as `In`, `Out` or `InOut`, which decides if a value goes into the function, comes back out of it, or both.
* [Physics](Physics): Extension: the original has no rigid body physics. `CreatePhysicsBody` and the commands that start with `Physics` add bodies that fall, collide, slide and rest, simulated by Jolt. Nothing in a program that does not use them changes.
* [Profiling your own code](Profiling): Extension: [Microseconds](Microseconds) times in millionths of a second, and `--profile` with the `Profile*` commands measures the parts of a program and of the runtime.
* [Quality improvements: Depth buffer](Quality-Improvements#depth-buffer): The depth buffer is a reversed 32-bit float, so distant surfaces z-fight much less.
* [Quality improvements: Large meshes](Quality-Improvements#large-meshes): A surface can hold more than 65535 vertices.
* [Quality improvements: Many lights](Quality-Improvements#many-lights): Up to 127 lights are visible per camera, and every draw is lit by its best eight.
* [Quality improvements: Mip maps](Quality-Improvements#mip-maps): Textures with flag 8 get a mip map chain and trilinear filtering, and can be given anisotropic filtering with a sampler.
* [Saving pictures](Saving-Pictures): Extension: [SaveBuffer](SaveBuffer), [SaveImage](SaveImage) and the new [SaveTexture](SaveTexture) write PNG, JPEG, WebP, JPEG XL, TGA, DDS and BMP files with settings, mark them as made by the program, and can encode on another thread with [AsyncSaving](AsyncSaving).
* [Scan Codes](Scan-Codes): Extension: `VKeyDown` and `VKeyHit` ask for a key by its SDL scancode, which every key has.
* [Sound resampling](Sound-Resampling): Sounds are resampled cleanly, so low rate sounds are duller; `BLITZLLVM_LEGACY_AUDIO_RESAMPLING` restores the FMOD sound.
* [Spherical fog](Spherical-Fog): Extension: `CameraFogMode camera, 2` fogs by the distance to the camera instead of the depth along its view direction; the original only has linear fog by depth.
* [Sprite depth fade (soft edges)](Sprite-Depth-Fade): Extension: `SpriteDepthFade` and `EntityDepthFade` fade see-through sprites and entities out where they get close to solid geometry (soft particles); the original has no such command.
* [The windows of BlitzPlus](Windows-of-BlitzPlus): Every window that `CreateWindow` makes on the desktop is a window of the operating system with a frame, a title bar and a thread of its own that shows it, `Graphics` keeps a window of its own, and a program needs no `Graphics` for its windows.
* [Types and numbers](Types): Extension: `Byte`, `UByte`, `Short`, `UShort`, `UInt`, `Long`, `ULong`, `Half` and `Double` work everywhere a type can be written.
* [Types and numbers: Number suffixes](Types#number-suffixes): Extension: number literals take a suffix that picks their type, such as `255ui8` or `0.1.d`.
* [Types and numbers: Void](Types#void): Extension: `Void` can be the return type of a function.
* [Userlib declarations](Userlib-Declarations): `.decls` files take the long type names as well as the short ones, for all the new types.
* [Vectors and matrices](Vectors-and-Matrices): Extension: `FloatVector3`, `IntVector4`, `FloatMatrix4x3` and the other vectors and matrices are values.

## Commands

Commands that differ from the original or are not finished, with the first of the differences from the "Differences" part of their page.

* [ActivateWindow](ActivateWindow#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The window is raised the way the operating system allows, which on some systems only raises it among the windows of your program and does not take the focus from another application.
* [ActiveObjects](ActiveObjects#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Windows and gadgets are not counted here.
* [ActiveWindow](ActiveWindow#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: There is no "none of ours is active" state: the answer is always the window of the program that was activated most recently, by the user or by [ActivateWindow](ActivateWindow).
* [AddVertex](AddVertex#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: `w` is ignored.
* [AnimateMD2](AnimateMD2#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The official help gives 1 as the default first frame; frames are counted from 0 and the default is 0, in the engine as well as here.
* [AntiAlias](AntiAlias#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original handed the setting to the graphics driver, where it did nothing on most hardware of the time.
* [AppTitle](AppTitle#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: It works before or after [Graphics](Graphics) alike: a title set before the window exists names the window when it is made, and one set later renames it.
* [AsyncLoading](AsyncLoading#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: With asynchronous loading on, a picture or model with a valid header that cannot be decoded raises its error when it is first used and not as a 0 from the load.
* [AsyncSaving](AsyncSaving#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: With asynchronous saving on, a file that can't be written (a folder that does not exist, a full disk) is not a 0 from the save command, but is counted by SavesFailed.
* [AvailVidMem](AvailVidMem#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The number is the memory budget the graphics driver reports for this program.
* [AvailVidMem64](AvailVidMem64#differences): The number is the memory budget the graphics driver reports for this program, so it also counts what other programs use.
* [BrushTexture](BrushTexture#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Layers 0 to 7 are accepted.
* [BSPAmbientLight](BSPAmbientLight#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original also lights the vertices of a level with point and spot lights, which have no effect on a level here.
* [BSPLighting](BSPLighting#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A level that has `light` entities is lit by them as point lights when lightmaps are off, instead of only by its vertex colors.
* [BufferDirty](BufferDirty#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Has no effect.
* [Byte](Byte#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [ByteSwap](ByteSwap#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals.
* [CameraFogMode](CameraFogMode#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Mode 2 is an extension of BlitzLLVM; the original only knows 0 and 1, and a program that uses 2 does not behave the same with the original Blitz3D.
* [CanvasBuffer](CanvasBuffer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The buffer has 32 bits of color (RGBA8) whatever depth `Graphics` has, and it is drawn to by the same renderer as the back buffer: `Cls`, the 2D commands, `RenderWorld`, `CopyRect`, `ReadPixel` and `LockBuffer` work in it the same way.
* [ChannelPan](ChannelPan#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Panning is done by turning down the opposite speaker, so the sound does not get louder when it is panned to one side.
* [ChannelPitch](ChannelPitch#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Changing the pitch also changes the speed, because the sound is resampled.
* [ChannelPlaying](ChannelPlaying#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A handle of 0, which the play commands give when there is no sound device or the sound failed to load, is never playing.
* [ChannelVolume](ChannelVolume#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the channel was never given out.
* [ClientHeight](ClientHeight#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The desktop is as big as the primary display (all of it, not only the area free of the task bar), where there is a display to ask.
* [ClientWidth](ClientWidth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The desktop is as big as the primary display (all of it, not only the area free of the task bar), where there is a display to ask.
* [CloseMovie](CloseMovie#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Nothing , the same as the original.
* [Collisions](Collisions#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Types outside 0 to 999, or a method outside 1 to 3, stop the program with a runtime error.
* [CollisionTime](CollisionTime#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The official help says this is the time taken to calculate the collision.
* [Confirm](Confirm#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The box is a message box of the operating system in front of the program's active window, not part of it.
* [CopyPixel](CopyPixel#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A source pixel outside of its buffer is read as 0 (black), and a destination outside its buffer is skipped.
* [CopyPixelFast](CopyPixelFast#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d`, and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message.
* [CopyRect](CopyRect#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Parts of the rectangle that lie outside of either buffer are cut off.
* [CountDisplayModes](CountDisplayModes#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
* [CountDisplays](CountDisplays#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: When SDL knows of no display, for example without a display driver, there is one display called "Default" with the common sizes of [CountGfxModes](CountGfxModes).
* [CountGfxDrivers](CountGfxDrivers#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Every GPU that Vulkan reports is a driver, including software ones.
* [CountGfxModes](CountGfxModes#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The modes are the ones of the main display.
* [CountHostAddresses](CountHostAddresses#differences): Not in the original, which only knows IPv4 ([CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs)).
* [CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Only IPv4 addresses are counted, use [CountHostAddresses](CountHostAddresses) for IPv6 too.
* [CountRefreshRates](CountRefreshRates#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
* [CreateButton](CreateButton#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Buttons are drawn in the look of the program, not with the controls of the operating system.
* [CreateCanvas](CreateCanvas#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Canvases are drawn by the same renderer as the rest of the interface, so nothing needs DirectX.
* [CreateComboBox](CreateComboBox#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The user cannot type into it, only pick from the list.
* [CreateCone](CreateCone#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original allows 3 to 100 segments.
* [CreateCylinder](CreateCylinder#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original allows 3 to 100 segments.
* [CreateHtmlView](CreateHtmlView#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: There is no web browser inside the window yet: the gadget is a frame that shows the address it was sent to, and no page is loaded.
* [CreateImage](CreateImage#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A graphics window must be open, because images live in video memory.
* [CreateLabel](CreateLabel#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Gadgets without a font of their own are drawn with Tahoma at 12 pixels, or a similar font of the system (the built-in bitmap font when there is none).
* [CreateListBox](CreateListBox#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Only one entry can be selected at a time.
* [CreateListener](CreateListener#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Volume falls off as 1 / (1 + rolloff * meters * 0.05), which is gentler than the curve of the original: the original (FMOD 3) is at full volume up to one meter and then falls off as meters ^ -rolloff, so at 20 meters with rolloff 1 it is at 5% where this runtime is at 50%.
* [CreateMenu](CreateMenu#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The shortcut underline for `&` is accepted but menus are only used with the mouse and the arrow keys.
* [CreatePhysicsBody](CreatePhysicsBody#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [CreatePhysicsBodyFromEntity](CreatePhysicsBodyFromEntity#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [CreatePhysicsConeConstraint](CreatePhysicsConeConstraint#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [CreatePhysicsDistanceConstraint](CreatePhysicsDistanceConstraint#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [CreatePhysicsFixedConstraint](CreatePhysicsFixedConstraint#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [CreatePhysicsHingeConstraint](CreatePhysicsHingeConstraint#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [CreatePhysicsPointConstraint](CreatePhysicsPointConstraint#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [CreatePhysicsSliderConstraint](CreatePhysicsSliderConstraint#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [CreatePhysicsWorld](CreatePhysicsWorld#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [CreatePlane](CreatePlane#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original allows 1 to 16 segments, and larger values can crash it or stop it with an error.
* [CreateSampler](CreateSampler#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which read every texture with the settings of its flags.
* [CreateSphere](CreateSphere#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original allows 2 to 100 segments.
* [CreateTabber](CreateTabber#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Gadgets created with the tabber as their group are drawn on it all the time, as in the original.
* [CreateTCPServer](CreateTCPServer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The server accepts IPv4 and IPv6 connections on the same port (where the system has IPv6), see [IPv6](IPv6).
* [CreateTerrain](CreateTerrain#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original only accepts powers of two (32, 64, 128 and so on) and stops with a runtime error otherwise.
* [CreateTextArea](CreateTextArea#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Without wrapping, a bar along the bottom appears once a line does not fit.
* [CreateTexture](CreateTexture#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Flag 4096 (render target) is new.
* [CreateToolBar](CreateToolBar#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The tool tips given with [SetToolBarTips](SetToolBarTips) show below a button after the mouse rested on it for half a second.
* [CreateUDPStream](CreateUDPStream#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The stream receives IPv4 and IPv6 messages (where the system has IPv6), see [IPv6](IPv6).
* [CreateWindow](CreateWindow#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Every window on the desktop is a window of the operating system, with its frame and title bar, so flag 1 only says whether the window has them, and the user moves, sizes, minimizes and maximizes it the way the system does.
* [DebugObjects](DebugObjects#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The list covers banks, streams, sounds, images, textures, fonts, timers and your own types, but no windows or gadgets.
* [Desktop](Desktop#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The windows are windows of the operating system on the desktop of the computer, whose size [ClientWidth](ClientWidth) and [ClientHeight](ClientHeight) tell.
* [DesktopBuffer](DesktopBuffer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Drawing on, or reading from, the desktop does not work: it is a buffer of one black pixel that starts over every time this is called, so the screen of the computer is never touched and nothing shows behind the windows.
* [DirectInputEnabled](DirectInputEnabled#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: There is no DirectInput on this platform.
* [DisplayDepth](DisplayDepth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
* [DisplayHeight](DisplayHeight#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
* [DisplayModeDepth](DisplayModeDepth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display or mode number that does not exist gives 0 instead of stopping the program, unlike [GfxModeWidth](GfxModeWidth).
* [DisplayModeHeight](DisplayModeHeight#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display or mode number that does not exist gives 0 instead of stopping the program, unlike [GfxModeWidth](GfxModeWidth).
* [DisplayModeRefreshRate](DisplayModeRefreshRate#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display or mode number that does not exist gives 0 instead of stopping the program, unlike [GfxModeWidth](GfxModeWidth).
* [DisplayModeWidth](DisplayModeWidth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display or mode number that does not exist gives 0 instead of stopping the program, unlike [GfxModeWidth](GfxModeWidth).
* [DisplayName](DisplayName#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
* [DisplayRefreshRate](DisplayRefreshRate#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display that does not tell its refresh rate is taken to have 60 Hz.
* [DisplayScale](DisplayScale#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
* [DisplayWidth](DisplayWidth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
* [DisplayX](DisplayX#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
* [DisplayY](DisplayY#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
* [Double](Double#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which only have the 32-bit real (`Float`).
* [DrawBlockRect](DrawBlockRect#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Only the part that lies inside the frame is drawn.
* [DrawImage](DrawImage#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A frame number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
* [DrawImageRect](DrawImageRect#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Only the part that lies inside the frame is drawn.
* [DrawMovie](DrawMovie#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Draws the newest picture whose time has come, stretched to the size given (smooth, not pixel by pixel).
* [EmitSound](EmitSound#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the sound is 0 (a sound that failed to load) or does not exist, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [EnableDirectInput](EnableDirectInput#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Only the value is remembered so that [DirectInputEnabled](DirectInputEnabled) can report it.
* [EndGraphics](EndGraphics#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original opens a new window of the default size, or a console.
* [EntityDepthFade](EntityDepthFade#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [EntityLighting](EntityLighting#differences): Not in the original: lighting is always per vertex there.
* [EntityStatic](EntityStatic#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [EntityTexture](EntityTexture#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the texture is not 0 and does not exist, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [Flip](Flip#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Without a graphics window nothing happens.
* [FlipCanvas](FlipCanvas#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The window of the canvas is drawn and handed to the thread that shows it right away, so a program that never waits for events still shows its canvases.
* [FlushJoy](FlushJoy#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Buttons that are currently held are not released.
* [FlushKeys](FlushKeys#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one keyboard.
* [FlushMouse](FlushMouse#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.
* [FontHeight](FontHeight#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The height is the height that was requested, as with Windows fonts.
* [FontWidth](FontWidth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Real fonts have a different width for each character, so this is the width of the widest one; use [StringWidth](StringWidth) for a text.
* [FormatTextAreaText](FormatTextAreaText#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Underline and strike-through are not supported, as in the original.
* [FreeFont](FreeFont#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A font that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
* [FreeImage](FreeImage#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Freeing a handle that is 0 or was already freed does nothing, while other commands stop with an error when they get such a handle.
* [FreePhysicsConstraint](FreePhysicsConstraint#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [FreePhysicsWorld](FreePhysicsWorld#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [FreeSound](FreeSound#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: FreeSound with a handle that was freed already, or with 0, is ignored.
* [FreeTexture](FreeTexture#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: [ActiveTextures](ActiveTextures) keeps counting a freed texture until the last entity or brush that uses it is gone.
* [FrontBuffer](FrontBuffer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The front buffer holds what the last Flip showed.
* [GammaBlue](GammaBlue#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The tables change what the window shows and never the gamma of the display, see [SetGamma](SetGamma).
* [GammaGreen](GammaGreen#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The tables change what the window shows and never the gamma of the display, see [SetGamma](SetGamma).
* [GammaRed](GammaRed#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The tables change what the window shows and never the gamma of the display, see [SetGamma](SetGamma).
* [GetBrushTexture](GetBrushTexture#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A layer without a texture gives 0.
* [GetHostAddress](GetHostAddress#differences): Without a call of [CountHostAddresses](CountHostAddresses) the addresses of this computer are used.
* [GetJoy](GetJoy#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Up to 32 buttons per joystick are supported, and a joystick with more reports only the first 32.
* [GetKey](GetKey#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The queue holds 64 characters, and the oldest ones are dropped when it is full.
* [GetMouse](GetMouse#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Buttons 4 and 5 (the back and forward buttons) are a BlitzLLVM extension.
* [GetMovieTexture](GetMovieTexture#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie does not exist, for example the 0 of a movie that failed to open, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [GetPhysicsAngularDamping](GetPhysicsAngularDamping#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsAngularVelocityX](GetPhysicsAngularVelocityX#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsAngularVelocityY](GetPhysicsAngularVelocityY#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsAngularVelocityZ](GetPhysicsAngularVelocityZ#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsAwake](GetPhysicsAwake#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsBaumgarte](GetPhysicsBaumgarte#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsBodyMotion](GetPhysicsBodyMotion#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsBodyShape](GetPhysicsBodyShape#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsBodyWorld](GetPhysicsBodyWorld#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsConstraintBroken](GetPhysicsConstraintBroken#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactCount](GetPhysicsContactCount#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactDepth](GetPhysicsContactDepth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactEntityA](GetPhysicsContactEntityA#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactEntityB](GetPhysicsContactEntityB#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactNX](GetPhysicsContactNX#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactNY](GetPhysicsContactNY#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactNZ](GetPhysicsContactNZ#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactReport](GetPhysicsContactReport#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactSensor](GetPhysicsContactSensor#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactSlop](GetPhysicsContactSlop#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactX](GetPhysicsContactX#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactY](GetPhysicsContactY#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContactZ](GetPhysicsContactZ#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContinuous](GetPhysicsContinuous#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsContinuousDefault](GetPhysicsContinuousDefault#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsDeterministic](GetPhysicsDeterministic#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsFriction](GetPhysicsFriction#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsGravityScale](GetPhysicsGravityScale#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsGravityX](GetPhysicsGravityX#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsGravityY](GetPhysicsGravityY#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsGravityZ](GetPhysicsGravityZ#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsHitDistance](GetPhysicsHitDistance#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsHitEntity](GetPhysicsHitEntity#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsHitNX](GetPhysicsHitNX#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsHitNY](GetPhysicsHitNY#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsHitNZ](GetPhysicsHitNZ#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsHitX](GetPhysicsHitX#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsHitY](GetPhysicsHitY#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsHitZ](GetPhysicsHitZ#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsLayer](GetPhysicsLayer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsLinearDamping](GetPhysicsLinearDamping#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsLinearVelocityX](GetPhysicsLinearVelocityX#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsLinearVelocityY](GetPhysicsLinearVelocityY#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsLinearVelocityZ](GetPhysicsLinearVelocityZ#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsMaskHigh](GetPhysicsMaskHigh#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsMaskLow](GetPhysicsMaskLow#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsMass](GetPhysicsMass#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsMaxDelta](GetPhysicsMaxDelta#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsMaxSteps](GetPhysicsMaxSteps#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsMode](GetPhysicsMode#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsOverlap](GetPhysicsOverlap#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsPositionIterations](GetPhysicsPositionIterations#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsRate](GetPhysicsRate#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsRestitution](GetPhysicsRestitution#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsSensor](GetPhysicsSensor#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsSleepThreshold](GetPhysicsSleepThreshold#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsSolver](GetPhysicsSolver#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsSpeculativeDistance](GetPhysicsSpeculativeDistance#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsSubsteps](GetPhysicsSubsteps#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsThreads](GetPhysicsThreads#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsVelocityIterations](GetPhysicsVelocityIterations#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetPhysicsWorldSleeping](GetPhysicsWorldSleeping#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [GetSurfaceBrush](GetSurfaceBrush#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A surface that was never painted gives a plain white brush.
* [GetTCPStreamAddress](GetTCPStreamAddress#differences): Not in the original, which only knows IPv4.
* [GetUDPMsgAddress](GetUDPMsgAddress#differences): Not in the original, which only knows IPv4.
* [GetUDPStreamAddress](GetUDPStreamAddress#differences): Not in the original, which only knows IPv4.
* [GfxDriver3D](GfxDriver3D#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A GPU can unless it does not do Vulkan 1.3 or has no queue that draws, which is 0.
* [GfxDriverCaps3D](GfxDriverCaps3D#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: It always reports 100: there are no cube maps, the texture flag for them is accepted and ignored.
* [GfxDriverName](GfxDriverName#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The name is the one that the GPU reports to Vulkan, such as "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER".
* [GfxModeDepth](GfxModeDepth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A mode number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
* [GfxModeExists](GfxModeExists#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A 0 for the width or height means "anything fits", like in BlitzPlus.
* [GfxModeFormat](GfxModeFormat#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Always 4, as the window is always 32 bit.
* [GfxModeHeight](GfxModeHeight#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A mode number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
* [GfxModeWidth](GfxModeWidth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A mode number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
* [GrabImage](GrabImage#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Parts that lie outside of the buffer are not copied and keep what the frame had before.
* [Graphics](Graphics#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: `Graphics` is the same command as [Graphics3D](Graphics3D): there is no 2D-only mode, so the 3D commands work after `Graphics` as well.
* [Graphics3D](Graphics3D#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Unlike in Blitz3D, mode 0 always opens a window, and `Graphics` and `Graphics3D` are the same command.
* [GraphicsDepth](GraphicsDepth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: It is the depth of the buffers that [Graphics](Graphics) or [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) made: 8, 12, 15, 16, 24, 30, 32 or 64, and 32 if the depth that was asked for is none of these.
* [GraphicsFormat](GraphicsFormat#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Always 4.
* [Half](Half#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which only have the 32-bit real (`Float`).
* [HidePointer](HidePointer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: BlitzPlus lets the pointer be hidden per canvas; here the canvas is accepted and ignored, as there is only one window pointer.
* [HostIP](HostIP#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Without a call of [CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs) the addresses of this computer are used.
* [HtmlViewEventURL](HtmlViewEventURL#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Always an empty text, as links cannot be clicked.
* [HtmlViewRun](HtmlViewRun#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The script is not run, as there is no page.
* [HtmlViewStatus](HtmlViewStatus#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Always 0, as no page is ever loaded or loading.
* [HWMultiTex](HWMultiTex#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Accepted and ignored.
* [HWRawInput](HWRawInput#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ImageBuffer](ImageBuffer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A frame number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
* [ImagesCollide](ImagesCollide#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A frame number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
* [Include](Include#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original opens a relative path from the folder the compiler runs in; BlitzLLVM starts at the file that includes it.
* [Input](Input#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Without a graphics window the prompt is written to the console (standard output) and the line is read from the console (standard input).
* [Int](Int#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The originals read a text with `atoi`, so `Int("$FF")` and `Int("0x10")` are 0 there.
* [JoyChanged](JoyChanged#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [JoyDeviceConnected](JoyDeviceConnected#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [JoyDeviceCount](JoyDeviceCount#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [JoyDeviceName](JoyDeviceName#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [JoyHat](JoyHat#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Without any joystick the original returns -1 as well, but this runtime returns 0, which looks like "up".
* [JoyType](JoyType#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original uses 1 for a digital and 2 for an analog joystick.
* [JoyWait](JoyWait#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: If no joystick is connected the function returns 0 right away instead of waiting forever.
* [KeyboardChanged](KeyboardChanged#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [KeyboardDeviceConnected](KeyboardDeviceConnected#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [KeyboardDeviceCount](KeyboardDeviceCount#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [KeyboardDeviceName](KeyboardDeviceName#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [KeyDown](KeyDown#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Keys that DirectInput has no code for, such as F16 to F24 and Help, are only reachable with VKeyDown.
* [KeyHit](KeyHit#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Keys that DirectInput has no code for, such as F16 to F24 and Help, are only reachable with VKeyHit.
* [LastJoyDevice](LastJoyDevice#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [LastKeyboardDevice](LastKeyboardDevice#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [LastMouseDevice](LastMouseDevice#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [LeadingZeros](LeadingZeros#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals.
* [Load3DSound](Load3DSound#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: See [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound) for what is simulated: volume falls off with the distance and the stereo position follows the angle to the listener, and the pitch is shifted when the sound or the listener moves (see [CreateListener](CreateListener)).
* [LoadAnimMesh](LoadAnimMesh#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Models in `.b3d`, `.3ds` and DirectX `.x` files can be loaded, see [LoadMesh](LoadMesh).
* [LoadAnimTexture](LoadAnimTexture#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: JPEG 2000 files do not load, and TIFF files with Deflate or JPEG compression do not, which the original read.
* [LoadBSP](LoadBSP#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Lightmaps are used: a face that has one is drawn with it, and the other faces get the colors of their vertices.
* [LoadBuffer](LoadBuffer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Formats other than BMP load as well, but not JPEG 2000 or TIFF with Deflate or JPEG compression, see [Image formats](Image-Formats).
* [LoaderMatrix](LoaderMatrix#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Only the matrix for `x` is used.
* [LoadFont](LoadFont#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Fonts are found in the font folders of the system by name, so a name such as "Arial" or "Courier New" needs that font installed, and common names fall back to a similar font (Helvetica to Arial, for one).
* [LoadImage](LoadImage#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A glTF file (`.glb` or `.gltf`) gives the pictures inside it: `"model.glb"` is the first and `"model.glb#2"` the third, see [Model formats](Model-Formats#gltf-gltf-glb).
* [LoadMesh](LoadMesh#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Models in `.b3d`, `.3ds` and DirectX `.x` files (text, binary and compressed) can be loaded; the other file types of the original do not exist.
* [LoadSound](LoadSound#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: MIDI , module and Windows Media files are not supported.
* [LoadTerrain](LoadTerrain#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The official help says that the red channel is used.
* [LoadTexture](LoadTexture#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Flag 2048 (sRGB conversion) and flag 4096 (render target) are new, see above.
* [Locate](Locate#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The position is limited to the window.
* [LockBuffer](LockBuffer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Up to 8 buffers can be locked at the same time.
* [LockedFormat](LockedFormat#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Always 4, because every buffer here has four bytes for each pixel (blue first, then green, red and an unused byte).
* [LockedPitch](LockedPitch#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: A buffer that [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) made with the depth 64 has 8 bytes for each pixel, so a row takes `width * 8` bytes.
* [LockedPixels](LockedPixels#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The bank is a copy of the pixels that is written back when the buffer is unlocked, it is not the memory of the graphics card.
* [LockMouse](LockMouse#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [LockTextArea](LockTextArea#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: While a text area is locked it sends no events for the changes you make.
* [Long](Long#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [LoopMovie](LoopMovie#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie does not exist, for example the 0 of a movie that failed to open, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [LoopSound](LoopSound#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: There is no command to switch looping off again.
* [MaximizeWindow](MaximizeWindow#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The operating system maximizes the window, also when it was made without flag 2 and so cannot be resized by the user; without a window manager nothing happens.
* [MeshCullBox](MeshCullBox#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The box only affects [EntityInView](EntityInView).
* [Microseconds](Microseconds#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The value is a `UInt64`, which no original command returns.
* [MinimizeWindow](MinimizeWindow#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The operating system minimizes the window and brings it back from its task bar; without a window manager nothing happens.
* [ModifyTerrain](ModifyTerrain#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The realtime argument has no effect.
* [MouseChanged](MouseChanged#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [MouseDeviceConnected](MouseDeviceConnected#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [MouseDeviceCount](MouseDeviceCount#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [MouseDeviceName](MouseDeviceName#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [MouseDown](MouseDown#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Buttons 4 and 5 (the back and forward buttons) are a BlitzLLVM extension.
* [MouseHit](MouseHit#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Buttons 4 and 5 (the back and forward buttons) are a BlitzLLVM extension.
* [MouseX](MouseX#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.
