* [MouseXSpeed](MouseXSpeed#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Putting the pointer somewhere with MoveMouse does not count as movement, the same as in the original.
* [MouseY](MouseY#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.
* [MouseYSpeed](MouseYSpeed#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.
* [MouseZ](MouseZ#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Fine scrolling wheels and touchpads that report fractions of a notch are rounded to whole steps.
* [MouseZSpeed](MouseZSpeed#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original only ever gives -1, 0 or 1.
* [MoveMouse](MoveMouse#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The pointer is not warped on the desktop.
* [MovieHeight](MovieHeight#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Nothing , the same as the original.
* [MovieLength](MovieLength#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie does not exist, for example the 0 of a movie that failed to open, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [MoviePlaying](MoviePlaying#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Nothing , the same as the original.
* [MoviePosition](MoviePosition#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie does not exist, for example the 0 of a movie that failed to open, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [MovieVolume](MovieVolume#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie does not exist, for example the 0 of a movie that failed to open, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [MovieWidth](MovieWidth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Nothing , the same as the original.
* [Notify](Notify#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The box is a message box of the operating system in front of the program's active window, not part of it.
* [OpenMovie](OpenMovie#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Movies are decoded by FFmpeg, whose shared libraries have to be next to the program: blitzcc copies them there when the program uses OpenMovie, and without them (or for a file that can't be played) the result is 0, which programs already have to handle.
* [OpenTCPStream](OpenTCPStream#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: IPv6 addresses and names that have them work.
* [PauseChannel](PauseChannel#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the channel was never given out.
* [PauseMovie](PauseMovie#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie does not exist, for example the 0 of a movie that failed to open, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [PhysicsAngularDamping](PhysicsAngularDamping#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.

* [PickedTime](PickedTime#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The official help describes this as the time taken to calculate the pick.
* [PlayCDTrack](PlayCDTrack#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Always returns 0 and plays nothing.
* [PlayMovie](PlayMovie#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie does not exist, for example the 0 of a movie that failed to open, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [PlayMusic](PlayMusic#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: MIDI is not supported, and neither are the tracker formats (MOD, S3M, XM, IT) and WMA.
* [PlaySound](PlaySound#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the sound is 0 (a sound that failed to load) or does not exist, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [PopCount](PopCount#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals.
* [Print](Print#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Without a graphics window the text goes to the console instead.
* [Proceed](Proceed#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The box is a message box of the operating system in front of the program's active window.
* [ProfileBegin](ProfileBegin#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProfileEnable](ProfileEnable#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProfileEnd](ProfileEnd#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProfileFlipCount](ProfileFlipCount#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProfileFPS](ProfileFPS#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProfileItemCount](ProfileItemCount#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProfileItemName](ProfileItemName#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProfileOutput](ProfileOutput#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProfileSample](ProfileSample#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProfileSlow](ProfileSlow#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProfileValue](ProfileValue#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ProjectedX](ProjectedX#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original returns 0 for X, Y and Z when the point is behind the camera or beyond the far plane.
* [ProjectedZ](ProjectedZ#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: In the original this is the distance of the camera's near plane, a constant for every point; it is 0 when the point is not visible.
* [QueryObject](QueryObject#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Queries 1 and 2 give a number for the window of the operating system that the gadget is in: the same number for every gadget in a window, and it is the runtime's number for the window, not an HWND that the Windows API can use.
* [RawInput](RawInput#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command, and gets its mouse speed from DirectInput.
* [RawInputEnabled](RawInputEnabled#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [ReadPixel](ReadPixel#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Without a lock the pixel has to be fetched from the graphics card, which makes this slow when it is used for many pixels.
* [ReadPixel64](ReadPixel64#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The color is not turned into an integer: the channels are Float16, and the returned number is the memory of the pixel (8 bytes for the depth 64, the 4 bytes of the stored word for the others).
* [ReadPixelFast](ReadPixelFast#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d` (a read gives 0), and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message.
* [ReadPixelFast64](ReadPixelFast64#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d` (a read gives 0), and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message.
* [RefreshRateAt](RefreshRateAt#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
* [RenderWorld](RenderWorld#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Entities that are made or hidden after [CaptureWorld](CaptureWorld) are drawn where they are, they do not fade in.
* [RequestColor](RequestColor#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The picker is drawn by the runtime inside the program's active window (in a window of its own where there is none) and is simpler than the Windows color dialog: three sliders and a preview, no palette and no custom colors.
* [RequestDir](RequestDir#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: It is the folder dialog of the operating system, in front of the program's active window, which differs between Windows, macOS and Linux.
* [RequestFile](RequestFile#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: It is the file dialog of the operating system, in front of the program's active window, so it looks different on each system.
* [RequestFont](RequestFont#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Only the size can be picked, from 8 to 32 points in a list, and the result is always the built-in font.
* [ResizeImage](ResizeImage#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The picture is stretched with smooth filtering, where the original used simple pixel picking.
* [ResumeChannel](ResumeChannel#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the channel was never given out.
* [RotL](RotL#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have `Shl`, `Shr` and `Sar` only.
* [RotR](RotR#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have `Shl`, `Shr` and `Sar` only.
* [RuntimeError](RuntimeError#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The message is printed as `Runtime Error: ...` on the standard error output, not shown in a dialog box.
* [SatByte](SatByte#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [SatInt](SatInt#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [SatLong](SatLong#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [SatShort](SatShort#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [SatUByte](SatUByte#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [SatUInt](SatUInt#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [SatULong](SatULong#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [SatUShort](SatUShort#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [SaveBuffer](SaveBuffer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original only writes BMP files.
* [SaveImage](SaveImage#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original only writes BMP files.
* [ScaleImage](ScaleImage#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Scaling uses the same smooth filter as [TFormImage](TFormImage), which [TFormFilter](TFormFilter) can turn off.
* [ScanLine](ScanLine#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Always returns 0.
* [SeekMovie](SeekMovie#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie does not exist, for example the 0 of a movie that failed to open, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [SendUDPMsg](SendUDPMsg#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Only IPv4 addresses fit in a number, use [SendUDPMsgTo](SendUDPMsgTo) for IPv6.
* [SendUDPMsgTo](SendUDPMsgTo#differences): Not in the original.
* [SetBuffer](SetBuffer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops with an error when the buffer is the `TextureBuffer` of a texture that was not made with flag 4096 (render target), see CreateTexture.
* [SetChannelFalloff](SetChannelFalloff#differences): A channel starts with the curve that [SetFalloff](SetFalloff) has set, so this is only needed for sounds that differ from the default.
* [SetCubeFace](SetCubeFace#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The face numbers follow the cube map of Direct3D: 0 is -X, 1 is +Z, 2 is +X, 3 is -Z, 4 is +Y and 5 is -Y.
* [SetCubeMode](SetCubeMode#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The faces are copied into one sheet whenever a scene that uses the cube map is drawn, so the edges between faces can show a thin seam when the picture is magnified a lot.
* [SetFalloff](SetFalloff#differences): Without a call the default is `0`, or what the environment variable `BLITZLLVM_VOLUME_FALLOFF` says, see [Environment variables](Environment-Variables).
* [SetFont](SetFont#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A font that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
* [SetGadgetFont](SetGadgetFont#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The gadget is drawn with the typeface of the font, and its text is measured in the widths of that font.
* [SetGamma](SetGamma#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original changed the gamma of the whole display, and left it that way until the program was done.
* [SetGfxDriver](SetGfxDriver#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Any number except 1 to [CountGfxDrivers](CountGfxDrivers) stops the program with an error message.
* [SetMenuText](SetMenuText#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The text can be read back with [MenuText](MenuText) here.
* [SetMinWindowSize](SetMinWindowSize#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: The help lists height before width in its syntax line, the real order is width then height.
* [SetSamplerAddressModeU](SetSamplerAddressModeU#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The mode has to be 0 to 3, other values stop the program with an error.
* [SetSamplerAddressModeV](SetSamplerAddressModeV#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The mode has to be 0 to 3, other values stop the program with an error.
* [SetSamplerAddressModeW](SetSamplerAddressModeW#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The mode has to be 0 to 3, other values stop the program with an error.
* [SetSamplerAnisotropy](SetSamplerAnisotropy#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The graphics card has a limit and the value is lowered to it, and a card that can not do anisotropic filtering reads as if it was 1.
* [SetSamplerBorderColor](SetSamplerBorderColor#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Graphics cards without the `VK_EXT_custom_border_color` extension can only do transparent black, opaque black and opaque white, so any other color is read as the closest of the three.
* [SetSamplerFilterMag](SetSamplerFilterMag#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The mode has to be 0 or 1, other values stop the program with an error.
* [SetSamplerFilterMin](SetSamplerFilterMin#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The mode has to be 0 or 1, other values stop the program with an error.
* [SetSamplerFilterMip](SetSamplerFilterMip#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The mode has to be 0 or 1, other values stop the program with an error.
* [SetSamplerLodBias](SetSamplerLodBias#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The graphics card has a limit for the bias, and the value is kept inside of it.
* [SetTextAreaFont](SetTextAreaFont#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Only the size of the font is used, every font is drawn with the built-in typeface.
* [SetToolBarTips](SetToolBarTips#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: A hint shows below its button after the mouse rested on it for half a second, in a yellow box, and goes when the mouse moves to another button or is pressed.
* [SetWindowSizeLimit](SetWindowSizeLimit#differences): Not in the original, which only has [SetMinWindowSize](SetMinWindowSize) and lets a window grow as big as the desktop.
* [Short](Short#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [ShowPointer](ShowPointer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: BlitzPlus lets the pointer be shown per canvas; here the canvas is accepted and ignored, as there is only one window pointer.
* [Single](Single#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which only have `Float`.
* [SoundPan](SoundPan#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the sound is 0 (a sound that failed to load) or does not exist, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [SoundPitch](SoundPitch#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the sound is 0 (a sound that failed to load) or does not exist, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [SoundVolume](SoundVolume#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the sound is 0 (a sound that failed to load) or does not exist, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [SpriteDepthFade](SpriteDepthFade#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: The original has no such command.
* [SpriteViewMode](SpriteViewMode#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The descriptions in the official help do not exactly match the engine.
* [StartNetGame](StartNetGame#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original showed a dialog box with the games found in the network.
* [Stats3D](Stats3D#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original also reports the vertices and triangles of the terrains in indexes 1 and 2.
* [Step](Step#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original only accepts a constant after `Step` and reports "Step value must be constant" otherwise.
* [Stop](Stop#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Only a build made with the debug option (`-d`) stops: it is a breakpoint for a debugger, and ends the program with a signal when none is attached.
* [StopChannel](StopChannel#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the channel was never given out.
* [StopMovie](StopMovie#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie does not exist, for example the 0 of a movie that failed to open, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [StringHeight](StringHeight#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Text has only one line, so this is always the height of one character.
* [StringWidth](StringWidth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: With the built-in bitmap font every character has the same width, so this is the number of characters times [FontWidth](FontWidth).
* [SystemProperty](SystemProperty#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Off Windows `windowsdir` and `systemdir` are the folders where the system keeps its settings and its libraries, not the Windows folders.
* [TCPStreamIP](TCPStreamIP#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A peer that uses IPv6 has no address as a number, so this returns 0 for it; use [GetTCPStreamAddress](GetTCPStreamAddress).
* [TerrainDetail](TerrainDetail#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The terrain has no level of detail here.
* [TerrainShading](TerrainShading#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The terrain is always lit with normals that follow the height, whatever this is set to.
* [Text](Text#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The built-in 8x8 pixel bitmap font is always used, scaled to the height of the current font.
* [TextureBlend](TextureBlend#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Layers that have no texture or a blend of 0 are left out, and the layers after them move up, so the first of the others is blended with the surface like the original does.
* [TextureBuffer](TextureBuffer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: RenderWorld into a texture buffer needs the texture to have flag 4096, which the original did not have; a debug build (`-d`) stops with an error otherwise.
* [TextureCoords](TextureCoords#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Only these two sets exist, the call sets or clears the same switch as the flag 65536 of LoadTexture and CreateTexture.
* [TextureHeight](TextureHeight#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the texture does not exist, other builds give 0, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [TextureName](TextureName#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original turns the path into lower case.
* [TextureWidth](TextureWidth#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the texture does not exist, other builds give 0, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
* [TFormImage](TFormImage#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A matrix that cannot be inverted (for example `a=0, b=0`) stops the program with an error message.
* [TotalVidMem](TotalVidMem#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The answer comes from the graphics card and is cut off at 2 GB, because it has to fit into an integer.
* [TrailingZeros](TrailingZeros#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals.
* [TrisRendered](TrisRendered#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A sprite drawn as an octagon (see [GPU optimizations](GPU-Optimizations#sprite-shapes)) counts as the 6 triangles that are drawn, not as 2, so scenes with many sprites count more than in the original.
* [UByte](UByte#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [UDPMsgIP](UDPMsgIP#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A sender that uses IPv6 has no address as a number, so this returns 0 for it; use [GetUDPMsgAddress](GetUDPMsgAddress).
* [UDPStreamIP](UDPStreamIP#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Only IPv4, use [GetUDPStreamAddress](GetUDPStreamAddress) for IPv6 too.
* [UInt](UInt#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [ULong](ULong#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [UnlockMouse](UnlockMouse#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [UpdateGamma](UpdateGamma#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The original gave the tables to the display.
* [UpdateWindowMenu](UpdateWindowMenu#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">: Menus here change the screen right away, so this command only asks for a redraw.
* [UShort](UShort#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
* [VertexTexCoords](VertexTexCoords#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: `w` is ignored.
* [VertexW](VertexW#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: The value is not stored: this always returns 1.
* [VKeyDown](VKeyDown#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [VKeyHit](VKeyHit#differences): This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
* [VWait](VWait#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: There is no vertical blank to wait for, so VWait waits 16 milliseconds for each frame (60 frames per second).
* [WaitJoy](WaitJoy#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: If no joystick is connected the function returns 0 right away instead of waiting forever.
* [WBuffer](WBuffer#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Does nothing: the depth buffer is always the same reversed 32 bit float one (see Differences).
* [WindowScale](WindowScale#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the original, whose windows are scaled by Windows without the program knowing.
* [WindowScaling](WindowScaling#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: Not in the original.
* [WireFrame](WireFrame#differences) <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: On a graphics driver that can not draw lines instead of triangles the call is ignored and the world stays solid.
* [Write](Write#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: Without a graphics window the text goes to the console instead.
* [WritePixel](WritePixel#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A position outside of the buffer is ignored.
* [WritePixel64](WritePixel64#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A position outside of the buffer is ignored.
* [WritePixelFast](WritePixelFast#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">: A buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d`, and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message.
* [WritePixelFast64](WritePixelFast64#differences) <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">: A position outside of the buffer is ignored, and a buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d` and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message.
